name: deployment-options
title: Deployment options
description: Cloud, self-hosted or hybrid side by side: who runs it, where data lives, what you manage and who it is for.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, and two to four options: an id, a name, a bestFor line that finishes "Best for ...", facts as label and value pairs, one cta and recommended. Use the same fact labels, in the same order, in every option. On a wide block every card is a subgrid over the same rows, so the Nth fact of every card sits on one line and each row is as tall as its tallest answer; under that the cards stack, each a column of facts, with the label beside its answer from 576px of width and above it on a phone. An option that lacks a fact the others have shows a dash, so the rows still line up. Recommended is written on the card, which also gets a heavier border and a solid button. No price appears: this is about fit, not billing. Two options sit side by side from 672px of width, three from 896px, and four go two by two and then four across from 1152px. align centres the heading; labels translates the fixed words.
